figures.finding: In 1998 the Comoros reported that its Nationality Code (art. 6) set legal majority at twenty-one while the Constitution gave the vote at eighteen, and that the draft Family Code would set majority at eighteen; the Family Code was adopted in June 2005 (marriage from eighteen, art. 14), but its majority article wasn't read.

sources.said: Article 6 of the Nationality Code stipulates that the age of legal majority is 21, whereas article 4 of the Constitution states that Comorian citizens are entitled to vote at the age of 18. According to the preliminary Family Code bill, the age of legal majority is 18.
Under article 14 of the Family Code, “men and women may not marry before they reach 18 years of age”.

figures.finding: In the Comoros, as in every OHADA state, a minor may hold shares in a company where liability stops at the contribution (a SARL, an SA or SAS, or as a limited partner) but cannot be a partner liable for the company's debts beyond it, and cannot trade unless emancipated; the Uniform Act sets no age of its own for a SARL's manager, who must be a natural person, so a manager's capacity is the national civil law's (majority or emancipation).

figures.applies: the Comoros is a state party to the OHADA Treaty (named in the 2008 treaty's preamble), whose Uniform Acts are directly applicable there, notwithstanding domestic law (art. 10). A minor's shares are subscribed through the legal administrator.

sources.said: Les mineurs et les majeurs incapables ne peuvent être associés d’une société dans laquelle ils seraient tenus des dettes sociales au‐delà de leurs apports.
La société à responsabilité limitée est gérée par une ou plusieurs personnes physiques, associées ou non.
Le mineur, sauf s'il est émancipé, ne peut avoir la qualité de commerçant ni effectuer des actes de commerce.
Les actes uniformes sont directement applicables et obligatoires dans les Etats-Parties, nonobstant toute disposition contraire de droit interne, antérieure ou postérieure.
Le Président de la République Fédérale Islamique des CO- MORES
